notes: Initial N-14 (combined prospectus/information statement) for an open-end mutual fund reorganisation within Matthews International Funds (d/b/a Matthews Asia Funds): Matthews Emerging Asia Fund (target) into Matthews Asia Small Companies Fund (acquirer), each class exchanged for the same class at equal aggregate NAV. No shareholder vote (Rule 17a-8), so meeting_date and record_date are null; the information-statement record date and the document date are blank placeholders ('[●], 2021'). No tickers printed. The acquirer's new name is printed inconsistently (Matthews Emerging Markets Small Companies Fund / Small Cap Fund / 'Matthew Emerging Markets Small Cap Fund'). security_class 'common' is a mapping of 'shares of beneficial interest' (Institutional and Investor Class) of an open-end fund; 'other' is defensible. The Agreement and Plan of Reorganization (Appendix B) is '[To come]'; the summary says it may be terminated or amended by mutual consent, with no outside date stated. Conditions also include the target's declaration of a dividend distributing undistributed income and gains (tax-motivated; not listed as a separate category; the 'other' element uses the representations-and-warranties condition).
